body: Joint Meeting of the Charter Amendment Committee and City Council
agenda_text:
JOINT MEETING OF THE CHARTER AMENDMENT
  COMMITTEE AND CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, JUNE 11, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

CHARTER AMENDMENT COMMITTEE  CITY COUNCIL

Mayor Rex Richardson, Chair  Rex Richardson, Mayor
All Members of City Council  Mary Zendejas, 1st District
  Cindy Allen, Vice Mayor, 2nd District
  Kristina Duggan, 3rd District
  Daryl Supernaw, 4th District
  Megan Kerr, 5th District
  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
  Roberto Uranga, 7th District
  Al Austin, 8th District
  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

HEARING

1.  24-53589  Recommendation to request the Mayor to convene the Charter Amendment
  Committee of the City Council on June 11, 2024, to conduct the first hearing of the
  Charter Amendment Committee, to receive and file comments from the community,
  receive and file supporting documentation into the record, and move to a second
  hearing the proposed amendment of City Charter Article XI (Civil Service
  Department) before the voters to combine the Civil Service and Human Resources
  Departments into one unified hiring department to manage all employee
  recruitment, hiring, and classified employee certifications; and establish an
  independent Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission to resolve
  complaints regarding Civil Service rules, to adjudicate classified employee
  disciplinary appeal; and to implement classified hiring preferences for Long Beach
  residents, students from local colleges and universities, current employees, and
  certain internships/apprenticeships. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Manager

  Page 1 of 2

  TUESDAY, JUNE 11, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53801  Recommendation to receive and file comments from the community, receive and
  file supporting documentation into the record, and move to a second public hearing
  of the proposed amendment to Long Beach City Charter Article V (Officers and
  Employees) to modify the length of terms for Harbor and Public Utilities
  Commissioners to four (4) years; and Article XII (Harbor Department) to modify the
  powers and duties of the Harbor Commission and annual budget timeline.

  Office or Department:  Harbor

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Joint Meeting of the Charter Amendment Committee and City Council on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless
extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
